personality_one_liner: A crisp, high-contrast, professional field utility tool emphasizing trust, speed, and absolute clarity under sunlight.

spacing.rule: Generous touch targets (44pt+) with structured vertical rhythm. Cards utilize full horizontal width with safe margins. Padding ensures absolute legibility.

do's: Use on sticky headers over scrolling content (like customer lists)
Use on floating action buttons (FAB) over tinted background
dont's: Avoid stacking multiple glass surfaces over each other

screens.name: SalesDashboard
screens.purpose: Daily command center for Sales showcasing total items sold, total revenue, and quick actions.

states.loading: Centered brand-tinted spinner over surface canvas.
states.empty: Illustration of water bottle with text 'Belum ada transaksi hari ini.' and primary CTA 'Mulai Transaksi'.
states.error: Text 'Gagal memuat data penjualan' with Retry button.

screens.layout: Sticky glass header with user code (e.g., A1). Top area features two large KPI cards (Total Uang, Terjual) using brandTertiary background. Below is a scrollable list of recent transactions. A sticky FAB at the bottom right for 'Scan QR / Manual Input'.

screens.name: TransactionForm
screens.purpose: Core POS flow for Sales to record orders, payments, debts, and loaned gallons.

states.empty: N/A - Form is prefilled with products.
states.error: Error toast if submission fails, retaining form state.

screens.layout: Customer profile summary at top. Vertical scrollable list of products (Galon 19L, cup, botol) with large +/- steppers. Below products: input fields for 'Bayar', 'Hutang', and 'Pinjam Galon'. Sticky glass bottom bar containing 'Kirim WA & Simpan' primary CTA.

screens.name: CustomerDirectory
screens.purpose: Database for Sales to track customer ranks, debts, and last purchase dates.

states.empty: Icon with text 'Belum ada pelanggan.' and 'Tambah Pelanggan' CTA.
states.error: Text 'Gagal memuat database' with Retry button.

screens.layout: Top sticky segmented control or filter chips (Urutkan: Ranking, Hutang, Lama Beli). Single-column scrollable list of customer cards. Each card displays Name, Barcode ID, last purchase date, and active debt in warning color if high.

screens.name: AdminReportView
screens.purpose: Admin screen to monitor daily aggregated sales per Sales Group.

states.empty: Icon of empty clipboard with 'Tidak ada laporan penjualan untuk tanggal ini'.
states.error: Text 'Gagal memuat laporan Admin' with Retry button.

screens.layout: Sticky date picker and group filter (e.g., A1-A100). Full-width metric cards summarizing total gallons and revenue. Below, an accordion or sectioned list showing detailed transactions per Sales Rep, separating cash, debt, and loaned gallons clearly.

hero_water_bottle.alt: Clean water delivery gallon bottle representing freshness and hydration

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly enforce the 'No Blue' rule. The palette utilizes Emerald Green (brandPrimary #10B981) to communicate freshness, trust, and clean water without relying on overused corporate blues.
Implement thick touch targets (44pt minimum) for all steppers, form inputs, and buttons. Sales reps will use this app in the field, often one-handed or in bright sunlight.

For the TransactionForm, guarantee the 'Kirim WA & Simpan' button remains sticky at the bottom above the safe area, housed within a glassmorphic or solid surface wrapper so scrolling product rows slide behind it.
Utilize Plus Jakarta Sans at weight 400 and 500 only. Rely on font scale rather than heavy font weights for hierarchy.
For the Admin screen, organize data visually to prevent mixing metrics from different groups. Use surfaceSecondary cards with clear divider lines.
Ensure WhatsApp deep-linking is triggered seamlessly on transaction completion, with fallback error handling if WA is not installed.
Include subtle haptics on stepper (+/-) presses and success confirmations.
Render the hero image with a top-to-bottom gradient scrim (transparent to surfaceInverse) if text is overlaid.
